methodology_note: Study units derived from Toronto Notes source structure (toc_inventory.json / derived/scope_packets/OP.json). OP's packet flags source-structure corruption at three points beyond the standard chapter-opening acronym-glossary merge (OP.S01, 'ACTOMYMS'/'Basic Anatomy Review', matching the OB/NS precedent): (1) OP.S03 ('OcularEmergencies') co-locates the real heading 'The Ocular Examination' via merged_duplicate_headings, and both are clinically substantive, so the node is split into two units (SU-OP-11, SU-OP-12) per the OB.S07 compound-title-split precedent rather than discarding one heading; (2) OP.S15 ('Malignancies') co-locates the real heading 'Ocular Manifestations of Systemic Disease', and its 13 topic children in fact span two themes, so they are grouped into a malignancy unit (SU-OP-42) and six systemic-disease units (SU-OP-43 to 49) by theme rather than by raw section title; (3) OP.S19's raw title 'Uveitis Common Medications' is RESOLVED (targeted follow-up, 2026-08-26) as a two-column OCR merge, not a genuine compound heading: 'The Uveal Tract' (research/tn2025/unresolved_headings.json's UNRESOLVED candidate) is a real, body-confirmed heading at pdf 1060 (TN OP20) introducing 'Uveitis' clinical content spanning pdf 1060-1061, while OP.S19's actual body content at OP44-45 is 'Common Medications' alone (no uveitis content). SU-OP-60 ('Uveitis') is now sourced from a synthetic UNCATALOGUED:TheUvealTract@pdf1060 id (chapter-A 'Monitoring' precedent) at pdf 1060-1061; SU-OP-61 (retitled 'Common Medications (Ophthalmic Reference Table)', REFERENCE_ONLY) remains sourced from OP.S19 at OP44-45. See research/scope/chapters/OP/review_items.json for the full resolution record. All 84 T-level topic nodes (OP.S0X.T0Y) are LOW-confidence TOC_OCR_UNANCHORED extractions inheriting their parent section's page range (SECTION_INHERITED precision). No page-image rendering was performed for this pass; the structural notes above are based on TOC-level evidence (titles, merged_duplicate_headings, unresolved_headings) only and are flagged for human page-image confirmation rather than asserted as resolved. Excluded as non-clinical organizational/reference material: the chapter root (OP), the Acronyms portion of OP.S01, OP.S20 (Landmark Ophthalmology Trials -- an EBM-summary table, consistent with the OB.S18/NS.S20 References-section precedent), and the References portion of OP.S21 ('Cataracts References'; its substantive T-child, Dislocated Lens, is retained as SU-OP-62).

study_units.title: Uveitis
study_units.structural_rationale: RESOLVED (targeted follow-up, 2026-08-26). research/tn2025/unresolved_headings.json records 'The UvealTract' (raw_ocr_line "The UvealTract ©. 2... ee OP20 ou") as UNRESOLVED, with its trailing page digits rejected as an untrusted anchor and a search window of pdf pages 1083-1084 checked -- which is exactly where this unit was originally, incorrectly, sourced from (OP.S19). Independent resolution via raw OCR of pdf page 1041 (the chapter's own TOC page, derived/toronto-notes-2025/ocr/pages/1041.json) shows the printed TOC is two columns the extraction read as one interleaved stream: '...Kayser-Fleischer Ring / The Uveal Tract...OP20 / [Uveitis - subordinate, same target] / LENS...OP21 / ...'; the scrambled line 'Uveitis Common Medications...OP44' is itself a merge of the stray 'Uveitis' column-A entry (pointing to the same OP20 target as 'The Uveal Tract', not a distinct page) with the real column-B heading 'Common Medications' at OP44 (see SU-OP-61). Raw OCR of pdf page 1060 (derived/toronto-notes-2025/ocr/pages/1060.json) body-confirms this: immediately after Kayser-Fleischer Ring, the page reads 'The Uveal Tract' (2-line anatomy definition: iris/ciliary body/choroid) then an 'Uveitis' sub-heading with full clinical content (idiopathic/autoimmune/infectious/granulomatous/malignant causes; anterior/intermediate/posterior/panuveitis classification) and Table 9 'Anatomic Classification of Uveitis' (etiology incl. HLA-B27 spondyloarthropathies, clinical features, complications, treatment per subtype), continuing onto pdf page 1061 (OP21, derived/toronto-notes-2025/ocr/pages/1061.json) before LENS/Cataracts content begins later on that same page. No toc_inventory.json node exists for 'The Uveal Tract' (its OP20 page-endpoint was silently absorbed into OP.S10 'Corea', and OP.S19 was built from the merged-column artifact rather than the true OP44-only 'Common Medications' heading). Represented as its own study unit sourced from a synthetic id (UNCATALOGUED: convention, per the chapter-A 'Monitoring' precedent) since no real toc_inventory.json node exists to cite. Classification/MCC evidence in crosswalk.json is UNCHANGED by this correction -- only the source_node_ids/page fields were wrong, not the clinical judgment; the content was already represented (as Uveitis), just mis-sourced.
